'''New Republic Special Operations''' was a division of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]] it was headed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Elements of Special Operations participated in the [[Battle of Mindor]]. The [[Rapid Response Task Force]] was part of Special Operations.
